leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the text-align property to horizontally align text within different HTML elements
Configure vertical-align to control the vertical positioning of inline and table-cell elements
Construct CSS rules that combine text-align and vertical-align for precise text positioning
Manipulate alignment properties to achieve specific layout requirements in web pages
Implement responsive text alignment strategies using CSS property values
Control text positioning within table cells using appropriate alignment properties
Integrate alignment properties with other CSS declarations to create cohesive text layouts
